blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — ACT Teachers Rep. Antonio Tinio on Tuesday urged lawmakers to increase allowances for civil servants by raising the funding for the Personal Economic Relief Allowance (Pera), a stipend whose amount has remained unchanged for 17 years. Tinio formalized his appeal by submitting a petition signed by more than 320,000 government workers to the office of House Speaker Faustino “Bojie” Dy III, as a sub-committee of select lawmakers plans to hold a meeting later this week to discuss proposed amendments to the P7.2-trillion spending plan. “We appeal to the speaker and the committee of appropriations led by chair Mika […]...
